UserStoryText: As a player, I want to see the dungeon grid so that I can plan my exploration.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a new run WHEN the game starts THEN a 9x10 grid with Start square below row 1 and End square above row 10 is displayed with all cells unvisited.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to move into king-adjacent unvisited squares so that I can explore the dungeon.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN my current cell WHEN I hover AND the target is king-adjacent AND unvisited THEN the target is highlighted as legal; WHEN I click a legal target THEN my marker moves, the old cell is marked visited, and an ink line is drawn.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want illegal squares to be unclickable so that I cannot accidentally break the rules.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a target that is already visited OR not king-adjacent OR outside the grid WHEN I click it THEN no action occurs AND a brief tooltip explains why.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to roll for room content when I enter a new square so that the dungeon feels unpredictable.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I move into a new cell WHEN content is pending THEN a d6 is rolled against the level table for that row AND the resolved content is revealed.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want empty, treasure, and potion rooms resolved automatically so that non-combat rooms don't slow me down.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a room resolves to Empty/Treasure/Potion WHEN content is revealed THEN counters update and the turn advances to step 6.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to fight monsters in a dice duel so that combat feels tactile and risky.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a monster room WHEN combat starts THEN each round runs: monster attack dice (count 6s as hits), my defence dice (count 6s as blocks), apply unblocked hits to HP, then my attack dice, then monster defence dice (Dracular only); the loop repeats until one side's HP reaches 0.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to see the result of each combat step so that I can trust the game's dice.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a combat round WHEN dice are rolled THEN each die's face value is shown, 6s are highlighted, and the resulting hit/block tally is displayed.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to convert potions into HP between rounds so that I can recover from damage.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN step 6 of the turn AND I have at least 1 potion AND HP < 17 WHEN I tap a potion THEN HP increases by 1 (capped at 17) and potion count decreases by 1.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to spend treasure on items at the end of my turn so that I can become stronger.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN step 7 of the turn AND I have at least 1 treasure WHEN I open the shop THEN affordable items are enabled, unaffordable items are disabled, and purchasing an item deducts its cost and applies its effect immediately.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to be prevented from buying items that conflict with ones I already own so that the slot rules are clear.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I own Item A that excludes Item B WHEN I view the shop THEN Item B is greyed out with tooltip 'Cannot be used with {A}'.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want potions bought at the shop to be usable next turn so that the original rule is preserved.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I buy a potion pack in step 7 WHEN the turn ends THEN the bought potions move from 'pending' to 'available' at the start of the next turn.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to be warned before making a move that blocks me from reaching End so that I don't lose unfairly.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a candidate move WHEN BFS reveals that the End square becomes unreachable after the move THEN the cell is shown with a warning icon AND clicking it opens a confirmation dialog.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want the game to clearly declare victory when I kill Dracular so that the outcome is unambiguous.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I fight Dracular AND his HP reaches 0 AND my HP > 0 THEN a VICTORY screen displays with run stats.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want the game to declare defeat when I die or become blocked so that I understand why the run ended.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN my HP reaches 0 OR BFS shows End unreachable THEN a DEFEAT screen displays with the cause and run stats.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want the game to enforce the 7-step turn order so that I can't accidentally skip a phase.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the current turn phase WHEN I attempt an action belonging to another phase THEN the action is blocked with an explanatory prompt.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a persistent HUD showing my stats so that I always know my status.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a run in progress THEN the HUD always shows HP/17, Attack Dice, Defence Dice, Treasure, Potions, and current equipment.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a start screen with Play and Tutorial options so that I can choose how to begin.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the app launches WHEN the main menu renders THEN Play, Tutorial, Settings, and Credits buttons are visible and functional.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a summary at the end of my run so that I can review my performance.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a run ends in victory or defeat WHEN the end screen opens THEN rooms visited, monsters killed, treasure earned, and elapsed time are displayed.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want my run to auto-save so that I can resume after closing the browser.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a run is in progress WHEN a turn completes THEN state is persisted to local storage AND loading the app resumes from the saved state.

UserStoryText: As a new player, I want a guided tutorial so that I can learn the 7-step turn sequence without reading the rules.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I select Tutorial WHEN the tutorial starts THEN a scripted micro-run runs with seeded dice, step-by-step narration, and completes with an option to start a real run.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want first-time-event tooltips so that new mechanics are explained when they first appear.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a one-shot event (first combat, first shop, first potion, first block warning) WHEN it fires THEN a single tooltip explains it AND does not repeat.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a help screen with the rules reference so that I can re-read the rules anytime.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN any screen WHEN I tap Help THEN a scrollable page shows the turn order, monster table, item table, and win/lose conditions.

UserStoryText: As a developer, I want a seeded, injectable RNG so that combat and content rolls are deterministic and testable.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a seed WHEN the game runs THEN all rolls are reproducible from that seed; WHEN a test injects a dice sequence THEN rolls consume from the sequence in order.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to browse monsters I've encountered so that I can learn the enemy roster.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I've killed a monster type at least once WHEN I open the Bestiary THEN that monster's name, AD, and flavour text are shown.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a confirmation dialog before entering the End square so that I don't enter the boss fight accidentally.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I select the End square WHEN I commit the move THEN a dialog asks 'Enter End square and fight Dracular?' with Cancel/Enter buttons.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to undo my last move before the content roll so that I can correct a misclick.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I just moved into a cell AND the d6 content roll has not yet happened WHEN I tap Undo THEN the move is reverted and the previous cell becomes current.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a run history with per-run statistics so that I can track my improvement.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN any number of completed runs WHEN I open the history screen THEN a list shows outcome, turn count, treasure earned, and date for each run.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want sound effects for moves, rolls, and combat so that the game feels alive.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN any gameplay action (move, roll, hit, block, purchase, potion, boss encounter) WHEN the action fires THEN an appropriate SFX plays AND settings can mute SFX.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want settings for volume, text size, and colour-blind mode so that I can customize my experience.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the Settings screen WHEN I change an option THEN the change applies immediately AND persists across sessions.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a daily seed challenge so that I can compete with myself and others on the same dungeon.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the Daily Seed button on the menu WHEN I tap it THEN a run starts using today's seed AND the seed is displayed for sharing.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want achievements for notable runs so that I have long-term goals.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I complete a run matching an achievement condition (e.g. no potions used, HP never below 5) WHEN the run ends THEN the achievement unlocks AND a toast confirms it.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to choose a difficulty mode so that the challenge matches my skill.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the start screen WHEN I select Easy/Normal/Hard/Nightmare THEN starting stats and/or boss stats adjust according to the difficulty config.

UserStoryText: As a screen-reader user, I want every dice roll and combat step narrated so that I can play without sight.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a screen reader is active WHEN a roll or combat step occurs THEN an ARIA live region announces the result in order.

UserStoryText: As a keyboard-only player, I want full keyboard navigation so that I can play without a mouse.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the grid is focused WHEN I press arrow keys (with shift for diagonals) THEN the cursor moves AND pressing Enter commits the move.

UserStoryText: As a colour-blind player, I want an alternative palette so that Treasure/Potion/Monster cells are distinguishable.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I enable colour-blind mode in settings WHEN any cell type is rendered THEN distinct patterns AND colours are used for each type.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want to install the game as a PWA so that I can play offline on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I visit the app on mobile WHEN I tap 'Add to Home Screen' THEN the app installs AND works offline after first load.

UserStoryText: As a player, I want a hand-drawn aesthetic so that the game feels like its paper origin.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN any screen WHEN it renders THEN grid lines, monsters, items, and UI chrome use a consistent sketch/ink style.
